book.name: Uibrani
book.title: Ubvur umbɔ aka atsɛnge abi Uibrani

content: Nggee, umɛn itsu amɛnmɛn ri iwe akakũ, asi iwea irherha arherhe ri itsi abinkɛ umɛn iki imesa ri itsi Ukiristo ri inggbaashia ukpekũ, akirakɛ aka awu atar idzin aki imangmangmɛn. Ake awu idzidzipa ri ifɛre iki ikũ umɛn izĩ ra akpe ni iwe ru imangmang ru Unum,
arherhi imesa iyi ubɔtisima, nu itsorhuwe abok, nu isisok ra akpe, nu itsu uvau iyi ugbagbaa.
Imɛ̃ɛ̃ngge umɛn iwe akakũ, Unum aba abemunga.
Abirabɛ aka anyãmbɔ irhirhang iyi idzidzɛrhe Unum na aka abanga agũmbɔ izũwãnga, abirabɛ aka akpombɔ iwu awɛrhu uzãrhã Ipfu Isarsatangge,
na aka abangumbɔ ize Arherhu-Num nu ijee ivangyɛ uku iba unuma,

na abvui adzipu undzingmbɔ ru Unum, isi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ iwengge ugɛ umbɔ abvui akũ umbɔ adzipa aba ru Unum. Akɛrɛ awu idzidzɛrhe, ubinkutsu iwu ugɛɛ umbɔ aka abvui anyapuwe Ungwɛ̃ Unum na adzowe unga atsa ra awiya.
Abĩkɛ aki ihwa inai ubɛn unum ngge idoi nu ake aka isaka amɛrke abin aka awe ru ugarh ra abirabɛ iki ikau ake, abĩ hã rakɔ iki iyɛi idorh Unum.
Bɔr abĩ aka amɛr ididɔk nu undzi, ashike ru ugarh nukpɔ. Abĩ hã Unum aka ayoka itsu ake ikponum. Ri imimaa ikɛi awuri ikpĩĩwe ake.
Umbi awɛrhamɛn umɛn iki ĩbema akarhãrhã, umɛn irherhumɛn rimi hã, bɔr umɛn iwemɛn ri ikeramɛn ugɛ umbi awe ru udĩ uku uze, udĩ hã uwu ukpu ififɔrh.
Unum asi iwea ri ida irhirhika, unga asi íyiruka itsermbi nu ibibemayɛ umbi aka adɛyiwe unga ri iyiyikeyɛ umbi aka akorhuwe abika adɔsa, ru nyaka umbi aki ikorhe.
Umɛn ibee ubɛn unera ru umbi atsu asunga ri idɛyiwe ikikorhe ha azĩ atsĩ imimasha, ngge itsú umbi akpo ubinkpi umbi aka afosa.
Umɛn isi ibeemɛn umbi awe ru ighɛrha, bɔr àka akorhe ru nyaka abirabɛ aka iyɛi ubinkpi Unum aka abemuwe ru ubok imangmang nu ibibimambɔ.
Itsuifɛr ibibemuwe-Num
Ivangyɛ Unum aka abemuwe Uibrahim, uwɔɔ aka ananga Unum ashia, nggee unga ayirh nggu itsinga,
agɛ, <<Awu idzidzɛrhe umum iwuri itsuka ungo idorh, umum iwuri itsu unangngo uwe urhɛrhɛ.>>
Mɔcɛ Uibrahim aka abima adzɛu, ayɛisa ubinkpi Unum aka abemuwe unga.
Anera aka isaka ayirh ri itsok unerwi aka ananga umbɔ, uyirh ha udɛyiwe ugɛ arherhanga awu idzidzɛrhe na akɛnke ubɛn uning.
Unum abee idɛyiwe ukupɛ̃ɛ̃ ra abirabɛ aka awe abi ukam ra abinkɛ unga aka abemuwe ugɛ abinkɛ unga aka abee ikorhe asi ífaruke. Nggee unga atsuafɛr nggu uyirh.

Ibibemuwe nu uyirh ha asi ífaruke, ubinkutsu, Unum asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ agbɛrangwĩ. Unum atsu ibibemuwe nu uyirh ha ngge itsú umɛn abirabɛ iki itĩ izĩ ru unga akaa umɛn, umɛn idɛ̃ɛ̃ ikpɔmmɛn ifosayɛ umbɔ aka atsu ra asumɛn na adzaa umɛn ififita akarhãrhã.
Umɛn iwe ru ifosa iyɛrɛ ngge iwe ubinkpi uku ukpɔm urhɛmɛn, ake ashike ni iwei nggu icicang. Ake anu itsĩrhã ru unɔrkang andzing urhaburhe anangkɛ aka asar anangke ananga kishoo,
anangkɛ Uyesu aka agbaashia azĩ ri itsimɛn. Unga awu Ukugɔng Uwuku Udzowe Idɛm-Num uwu ugbagbaa ri itɔ̃ itser iyi Unum ru nyaka Umarhkizadak.
